meta.title: Only Chat
meta.description: Adds an Only Chat entry to the sidebar. One click starts (or reuses) a chat with any model and opens it in the main panel with the usual composer and model picker — you never choose a workspace. Chats run your own default Agent preset, so they keep the same capabilities as an ordinary session (skills, commands, jobs, goals, planning, compaction, subagents, web, office tools) with one difference: read-only. Each chat pins the deployment's read-only permission preset, the sandbox refuses file changes a command attempts, and write, edit, apply_patch, MCP tools, the profile editors, the package runner, and working_directory are refused at execution time in the chat's own scope. Read tools still reach any readable path. While a chat is open the sidebar shows this plugin's own chat list (keep, convert, delete on hover) and no other workspace; leaving chat mode returns the host workspace browser and removes the Only Chat workspace row, which exists only while chatting. Settings → Only Chat holds the same list, delete-all, the keep-at-most limit (default 20), and Convert to a session, which copies a chat into a workspace as a normal session and deletes the chat; that conversion is one-way. Starting a chat past the limit deletes the least recently active idle chats; a chat that is generating or kept (pinned) is left alone. Disabling the plugin hides the entry and the settings page and leaves existing chat logs in place.
